description: This file defines a template class 'flat_map' which implements a map-like container using a sorted vector, inheriting core functionality from 'flat_tree'. It includes constructors, assignment operators, insert, erase, search, and swap methods, and is part of the 'base' namespace. The class supports C++14 map interface and is optimized for memory locality and low overhead for small maps.

classes.name: flat_map
classes.description: A map-like container implemented as a sorted vector, supporting C++14 map interface, with insert, erase, find, and other map operations.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Access or insert element by key, returning reference to mapped value.

methods.name: insert_or_assign
methods.description: Insert a key-value pair or assign if key exists.

methods.name: try_emplace
methods.description: Construct and insert element if key does not exist.
